Article Title: 'I apologise on his behalf': Tamil Nadu CM Vijay after minister's Karunanidhi reference
Article Text:
Vijay apologises on minister's behalf for his Karunanidhi reference

Tamil Nadu chief minister C Vijay Joseph apologised in the assembly on Monday after a minister referred to former CM and DMK patriarch late M Karunanidhi by name without using the customary respectful honorific.State forest minister R V Ranjith Kumar’s reference to the late DMK leader as “Karunanidhi”, without the traditional “Kalaignar” (scholar), triggered protests from opposition DMK members.Vijay intervened to defuse the tension, admitting that the reference was inappropriate and apologising on the minister’s behalf.“I apologise on his behalf,” Vijay said.The row erupted during a debate on demands for grants for the health and revenue departments. Ranjith Kumar was criticising alleged cash-for-votes practices and referred to the controversial “Thirumangalam formula”.He claimed that up to Rs 1,500 per vote had been distributed in his Kancheepuram constituency during previous elections. He contrasted this with the current government, saying it came to power without distributing money for votes.While referring to past election tactics, Ranjith Kumar mentioned Karunanidhi without the customary “Kalaignar” or “former chief minister” prefix. DMK members, led by former minister K K S S R Ramachandran, immediately protested, citing the assembly’s long-standing convention of using respectful titles for revered leaders.Vijay then halted the forest minister’s speech and intervened to prevent the protest from escalating, acknowledging that referring to the late leader without the customary honorific was inappropriate.
Article Summary: State forest minister R V Ranjith Kumar’s reference to the late DMK leader as “Karunanidhi’, without the traditional “Kalaignar’ (scholar) triggered protests from opposition DMK members. Chief minister C Vijay Joseph intervened to defuse the tension.

NEW DELHI: The C Joseph Vijay-led Tamil Nadu government on Wednesday withdrew an order barring students from joining protests organised by Left parties and the Cockroach Janata Party ( CJP ).Earlier, the directive had asked education departments, police and district administrations to coordinate efforts to discourage participation and submit reports on the action taken.The communication, issued by the Directorate of Collegiate Education, specifically referred to protest and agitation programmes organised by Left-wing parties and the CJP. Article Title: Delhi Jal Board case: Satyendar Jain, four others sent to 14-day judicial custody
Article Text:
The case relates to alleged irregularities in the tendering process for the augmentation and upgradation of sewage treatment plants (STPs) under the DJB.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Rouse Avenue Court on Wednesday remanded former Delhi minister and AAP leader Satyendar Jain and four other accused to 14-day judicial custody in connection with an alleged corruption case involving the Delhi Jal Board (DJB).The court also remanded accused Ankit Shrivastava to two-day police custody. The bail applications in the case have been listed for hearing on August 25, while the court issued notices on the bail pleas.The Anti-Corruption Branch (ACB) had produced Jain and the other accused before the court after arresting them in connection with an FIR registered on May 11, 2024. The case relates to alleged irregularities in the tendering process for the augmentation and upgradation of sewage treatment plants (STPs) under the DJB.The FIR was registered under Sections 7, 7A, 9 and 13 of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, as amended in 2018, along with provisions of the Indian Penal Code relating to cheating, criminal breach of trust and criminal conspiracy.Following Jain's arrest, AAP national convenor Arvind Kejriwal questioned Union home minister Amit Shah over the action, alleging that the ACB had been pressured to arrest the former minister.In a post on X, Kejriwal said, "Amit Shah ji should explain why he got Satyendra Jain arrested by pressuring the investigation agency."Kejriwal further alleged that an ACB official had claimed there was no plan to arrest Jain until Wednesday morning, before a call was allegedly made by Shah directing the arrest.Meanwhile, BJP MP and former AAP leader Swati Maliwal accused Kejriwal of running a "shop of corruption" during his decade in Delhi politics. She alleged that he avoided holding any ministry during his tenure as chief minister to shift responsibility to ministers when allegations of wrongdoing emerged.
Article Summary: Satyendar Jain and four other accused remanded to 14-day judicial custody. Court also remanded accused Ankit Shrivastava to two-day police custody. The case relates to alleged irregularities in the tendering process for the augmentation and upgradation of sewage treatment plants.

Article Title: Will hold retest of 3 subjects of UGC-NET: Govt
Article Text: NEW DELHI: Centre informed Delhi high court Wednesday that a retest is being conducted for three subjects of UGC-NET June-2026 examination, including Sociology, following complaints of errors in the question papers.Taking note of the submission by solicitor general Tushar Mehta, Justice Jasmeet Singh disposed of a plea filed by a candidate who appeared for the Sociology exam, which sought a stay on the declaration of results pending an independent probe and re-conduct of the exam following allegations of paper leak and errors in the question paper.While English and Commerce papers will be held on Sept 9, the Sociology paper will be held on Sept 10, Mehta told Delhi HC, adding that the decision addresses the student's grievance.In a public notice, NTA had acknowledged that it received several complaints about multiple errors in the question papers of three subjects and formed a committee to look into the matter. Article Summary: Centre informed Delhi high court Wednesday that a retest is being conducted for three subjects of UGC-NET June-2026 examination, including Sociology. Article Title: If accused has right to silence, cops have right to arrest: SC
Article Text:
Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Accused of not answering any questions relating to a land grabbing case, counsel for Sumit Roy, PA to TMC general secretary, attempted to brush it aside by saying the accused has a constitutional right to remain silent but was countered by the Supreme Court on Wednesday that the police have an equal right to arrest.Solicitor general Tushar Mehta submitted in sealed cover the details of modus operandi adopted by Roy in Salboni land-grabbing case, in which the Calcutta HC had refused him anticipatory bail but on appeal, the SC had granted him interim pre-arrest bail on the condition that he would present himself before the investigation officer daily and cooperate with the probe.Mehta said that though Roy appears before the IO, he refuses to answer the questions posed to him relating to his alleged complicity and direct involvement in the land grabbing case. Roy’s counsel Gopal Sankaranarayanan said in the five-year-old case, the FIR was registered by police only after the election results were declared hinting at political vendetta by the BJP govt.Mehta said that it was not possible to register an FIR during the reign of TMC govt and reiterated his accusation that since the accused is neither cooperating in the investigations nor answering the questions, the police would require his custodial interrogation.Sankaranarayanan attempted to ridicule the SG’s accusation by saying “that (silence) is Roy’s entitlement under the Constitution. I am afraid you should read it to understand what it is. He is entitled to his silence and entitled not to answer any question. That is a constitutional right.”The bench curtly told Sankaranarayanan that “as much the Constitution preserves your right to silence, the Constitution also secures the investigating agency the right to arrest.”Mehta requested the court to peruse the detailed probe status report and decide whether its Aug 6 order granting interim anticipatory bail to Roy deserved to be recalled enabling police arrest and subject him to custodial interrogation.The bench in its order said, “The SG, representing West Bengal govt, has handed over some material gathered during investigations. The same be kept in a sealed cover and sent at the residential offices of the Judges. Interim protection granted to the petitioner by the Aug 6 order shall continue to operate till further orders.” SC posted the case for hearing on Aug 31.
Article Summary: Sumit Roy, PA to TMC general secretary, is accused of not answering questions in a land grabbing case. Solicitor general Tushar Mehta submitted in sealed cover the details of modus operandi adopted by Roy. Roy’s counsel Gopal Sankaranarayanan said in the five-year-old case, the FIR was registered by police only after the election results were declared hinting at political vendetta.

Article Title: PM Modi's Gen Z, Gen Alpha outreach: Ministers told to visit universities, govt schools
Article Text:
PM Modi asked ministers to improve their social media presence.

NEW DELHI: PM Narendra Modi Wednesday asked ministers to spend a day at universities interacting with students and also visit govt schools in their constituencies to assess the facilities being provided to children, including mid-day meals. The twin directives are aimed at strengthening engagement with Gen Z and Gen Alpha (aged 5-15).During the Cabinet meeting, the overall social media performance, ranking of all ministers, was also shared. This was carried out based on activity, engagement and traction across platforms, including Instagram, X, Facebook and LinkedIn from May 1 to Aug 15. PM topped the list. Among ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, Piyush Goyal, Ashwini Vaishnaw and CR Paatil were among the top performers.TOI has learnt that PM asked ministers to improve their social media presence and have engaging communication through these platforms rather than just posting or reposting govt decisions.People aware of the discussion said the performance of BJP leaders and other political leaders were also shared with ministers for reference and to assess how they can work on to improve their presence and engagement on these platforms.UP CM Yogi Adityanath was among the top performers, alongside Congress’s Rahul Gandhi, who is leader of the opposition in Lok Sabha, AAP chief Arvind Kejriwal and Tamil Nadu CM C Joseph Vijay.For ranking and social media performance report, the assessment considered average daily posts, total engagement, average engagement per post, likes, average likes and follower count across all the platforms.While the initiative of “One Day, One University” programme comes in the backdrop of student protests, the push to reach out to Gen Alpha and visiting schools gains significance in the light of children raising demand for basic facilities, teachers and good quality food. CJP, which led the protests at Jantar Mantar, has also launched a programme to assess the gaps in govt schools.It’s learnt that ministers have also been asked to send their local representatives regularly to see the functioning and facilities at govt schools.PM also told ministers to assess how they can also provide AI skill training to youth, which was part of the Independence Day announcements. Modi has asked ministers to focus on the areas that he has outlined under “Sapta Dhara”.
Article Summary: PM Narendra Modi asked ministers to spend a day at universities interacting with students. He also asked them to visit govt schools in their constituencies to assess facilities. The twin directives are aimed at strengthening engagement with Gen Z and Gen Alpha (aged 5-15)

Article Title: Congress may move court if Pune curfew blocks Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Chhatron ki Goonj’ event
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: Congress is planning to move court to seek permission for Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Chhatron ki Goonj’ programme in Pune if it is stopped by the district administration’s curfew for the coming fortnight.Rahul’s student convention is planned for Pune on August 22, while the administration is said to have imposed a ban on the gathering of more than four persons from August 18-31.The party is learnt to have secured permission from a city college that is to serve as the venue of the programme. It applied for permission from police and municipal corporation Monday, coinciding with the information about imposition of curfew.The district administration is said to have issued the ban on big gatherings with an eye on protests and festivals, but Congress views the sudden order as targeted at its upcoming programme.‘Chhatron ki Goonj’ conventions are aimed exclusively at students, with Rahul coming up with the series to deepen connect with Gen Z in the wake of NEET paper leak related protests at Jantar Mantar. The Pune leg has the novelty of being exclusively for girls, with Rahul himself making the announcement on Sunday.“Dehradun administration rescinded permission for July 17 for the main Parade Ground and the venue had to be shifted. The same problem was faced in Allahabad on August 8. Rajasthan govt also tried to block the first of the series of the programme in Kota on June 17. Now, it is Pune. The curfew is clearly aimed at our programme,” a party functionary said.Sources said that if Pune denies permission, Congress will move court and seek a direction to the district administration.Congress strategists believe the programme’s targeted wooing of the young has disturbed its political rival BJP, which is looking to undercut its programmes. That Rajasthan, Uttarakhand, UP and Maharashtra are all governed by BJP has only deepened the suspicion in the party.
Article Summary: Rahul’s student convention is planned for Pune on August 22. The administration is said to have imposed a ban on the gathering of more than four persons. The party is learnt to have secured permission from a city college that is to serve as the venue of the programme.

NEW DELHI: AAP leader and former Delhi minister Satyendar Jain on Wednesday linked his arrest by the Delhi government's anti-corruption branch (ACB) to the upcoming Punjab assembly elections The arrest of the Kejriwal loyalist came a day earlier in connection with alleged irregularities in the Delhi Jal Board 's (DJB) tendering process."This is being done because of the Punjab elections," Jain was quoted as saying by news agency ANI after a court hearing in the case.Before the hearing in the alleged DJB scam case began, senior advocate Maninder Singh, appearing for Jain, said, "Supreme Court guidelines have been violated. The grounds of arrest are missing."Meanwhile former Delhi chief minister and AAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal has also questioned the arrest of his party colleague Satyendar Jain by the Delhi Police.Taking to X, party boss Kejriwal wrote: “An arrest is made when the police need to interrogate and investigate a person. Article Title: 'He would get corruption done': Swati Maliwal targets Kejriwal after Satyendar Jain's arrest

NEW DELHI: Rajya Sabha member Swati Maliwal on Wednesday accused former Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal of presiding over a decade of corruption in the national capital, alleging irregularities in projects including classroom construction and the liquor policy."In last 10 years in Delhi, Arvind Kejriwal was running a shop of corruption, be it construction of classrooms, liquor scam, they did many of such scams," BJP leader Maliwal said.Maliwal alleged that Kejriwal deliberately kept himself away from ministerial portfolios and allowed corruption to be carried out through ministers, whom he later blamed when allegations surfaced."Arvind Kejriwal functioned cleverly, he did not handle any of the ministry, he would get the corruption done through the minister, and then when the minister used to be exposed, he would blame the minister," Maliwal added.She also alleged that Aam Aadmi Party leader Satyendar Jain was acting as a “collection agent” for the party in Punjab."Now the STP scam of the DJB that came to the fore, it is a very serious scam, because the STPs are important aspect of Yamuna cleaning. Satyendar Jain is acting as a collection agent for AAP in Punjab," Maliwal said.AAP leader and former Delhi minister Satyendar Jain was arrested in connection with alleged corruption in the Delhi Jal Board, an official told news agency ANI.The Delhi government’s Anti-Corruption Branch (ACB) has arrested six people in the case, including former Delhi Jal Board CEO Udit Prakash Rai, former contractual consultant Ankit Srivastava and three private individuals — Nagendra Yadav, Raja Kumar Kurra and Pankaj Verma.The arrests were made in connection with an FIR registered by the ACB on May 11, 2024, under provisions of the Prevention of Corruption Act and the Indian Penal Code. The case includes charges related to bribery, criminal breach of trust, cheating and criminal conspiracy.The FIR was registered on a complaint by the Directorate of Vigilance, GNCTD, alleging large-scale irregularities, manipulation of tender conditions and criminal conspiracy in the tendering process for the augmentation and upgradation of sewage treatment plants (STPs) of the Delhi Jal Board.AAP chief and former Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal attacked the BJP over Jain's arrest, saying his party colleague was arrested on the "BJP's behest".Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leader Atishi on Wednesday also alleged that the arrest of former Delhi minister Satyendar Jain was part of a BJP conspiracy and “witch-hunt”.“The arrest of Aam Aadmi Party leader Satyendar Jain is part of a BJP conspiracy and 'witch-hunt'. Now, as the co-in-charge for Punjab—where elections are scheduled for February—he is once again being targeted as part of a BJP conspiracy. .. The people of Punjab will certainly give a befitting reply to these attempts to harass the Aam Aadmi Party in the state,” she said.
Article Summary: Rajya Sabha member Swati Maliwal accused former Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal of presiding over a decade of corruption in the national capital. She alleged irregularities in projects including classroom construction and the liquor policy. She also alleged that Aam Aadmi Party leader Satyendar Jain was acting as a “collection agent” for the party in Punjab.

Article Title: 'Ready to show degree but ask pawpaw too': CJP chief Dipke amid row over Boston education

NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) chief Abhijeet Dipke has offered to show his degree from Boston University amid questions over his educational background, while challenging Prime Minister Narendra Modi to do the same.Addressing the controversy in a social media post, Dipke said he was willing to provide documents to establish that he had attended the US university.“Hello everyone, I’ve been noticing for the last few days that people have been calling me a fraud and saying I never went to Boston University. I am ready to show my degree. But will your Pawpaw show his degree?” he said.“I am ready to show my degree but what about pawpaw? I am ready. I have all the documents,” he added.A community note attached to his post, however, said records relating to PM Modi's educational qualifications had already been made public.“Narendra Modi’s Bachelor’s and Master’s degree records have been publicly available for a considerable period of time,” the note said, while linking to a 2016 BJP post that showcased Modi's BA and MA degree records.In a separate post, Dipke drew a comparison between Boston University and Delhi University , asking why the latter had not highlighted PM Modi's association with the institution.“Boston University published an article about me for being their alumnus. Why doesn’t DU proudly celebrate Modi as their alumnus? He is, after all, the Prime Minister of India. Shouldn’t they be flexing about it instead of trying to hide his degree?” he said.This post also attracted a community note, which stated that Delhi University had published a list of Union cabinet ministers who were its alumni and that PM Modi was included in the list.Dipke has earlier said that he received a scholarship from Boston University and financed the remaining expenses through an education loan, which he is still repaying.The 30-year-old holds a Master of Science degree in Public Relations from Boston University. He returned to India in June and led the Cockroach Janta Party's agitation over the alleged NEET-UG 2026 paper leak, with the protests eventually leading to the resignation of then education minister Dharmendra Pradhan.

Article Title: Rahul Gandhi defamation case: Savarkar’s grandson admits Nathuram, Gopal Godse were active RSS members
Article Text:
Pune:





In a significant development in the defamation case involving Congress leader Rahul Gandhi , filed by Savarkar’s grandson Satyaki Savarkar, the complainant on Monday admitted that Nathuram Godse and his brother Gopal Godse were “active members” of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS).The admission came during further cross-examination of Satyaki Savarkar by Gandhi’s counsel Milind D Pawar, appearing for Rahul Gandhi, before judicial magistrate first class (JMFC) Amol Shriram Shinde. The deposition records Satyaki as stating: “It is true to say that, my grandfathers Gopal Godse and Nathuram Godse were active members of Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh.”The cross-examination also brought out the family links between the Savarkars and Godses. Satyaki said Gopal Godse was his maternal grandfather and Sindhu Godse his maternal grandmother, while his mother was Himani Savarkar. He also confirmed that Gopal and Nathuram Godse were real brothers and described Nathuram as his grand-uncle. He further agreed that the Savarkar and Godse families were related. The witness also admitted that his mother and Gopal Godse worked for the Hindu Mahasabha until their deaths.The cross-examination also dealt with the 1948 assassination of Mahatma Gandhi. Satyaki agreed that Gandhi was assassinated at Birla House in Delhi on Jan 30, 1948, and that Gopal Godse and Vinayak Damodar Savarkar were accused in the case.The defence also questioned Satyaki about an alleged interview given by Gopal Godse to a monthly magazine on Jan 28, 1994. Satyaki said he did not know about the interview. He similarly said he did not know whether Nathuram Godse had worked as an “intellectual executive” in 1944.The complainant’s lawyer, Sangram Kolhatkar, objected to some of the questions concerning the RSS and Digambar Badge, arguing that they were not related to the case. The court recorded that the objections would be decided at the time of the final decision.The cross-examination remained incomplete and was deferred to Sept 1.
Article Summary: Nathuram Godse and his brother Gopal Godse were ‘active members’ of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh. The admission came during further cross-examination of Satyaki Savarkar.

Article Title: Political pressure behind Jain’s arrest: Kejriwal. He was involved in DJB scam: Rekha
Article Text:
New Delhi:





AAP chief Arvind Kejriwal Wednesday alleged that the arrest of Satyendar Jain was carried out “under political pressure”.However, chief minister Rekha Gupta said Jain was involved in a “scam” in Delhi Jal Board (DJB) and that investigating agencies were doing their job.Delhi BJP president Harsh Malhotra said AAP functionaries were playing the political victim card when “when investigations and arrests are taking place in connection with their misdeeds in Delhi”. DJB was the “biggest centre of financial irregularities” under the erstwhile Kejriwal govt, he said, adding, “when the complete investigation report comes out, Kejriwal himself may possibly go to jail.”Earlier in the day, the AAP chief posted on X, “An ACB official revealed — ACB had no plan until (Tuesday) morning to arrest Jain. Then in the afternoon, a direct call came... to arrest him.” He wrote in another post, “A person is arrested when police need to question and investigate that person. Police did not even take Jain into custody. This means they do not have to question him.”AAP Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh said the arrest of Jain, AAP’s Punjab unit co-in-charge, was “an act of panic amid BJP’s expected defeat” in the 2027 assembly elections. “BJP wants to suppress AAP and win the Punjab polls by using every means at its disposal,” he claimed.Rubbishing the claim, Delhi BJP spokesperson Praveen Shankar Kapoor said: “AAP told the same story on May 30, 2022, when they claimed that Jain was arrested (then) because he was the party in charge for Himachal Pradesh polls. In that elections, AAP received just 1% of the votes and won zero seats. It faces a similar fate in Punjab in 2027 as the ‘game of loot’ is on there.”BJP MP Manoj Tiwari said regardless of what AAP functionaries claim, “concrete evidence of corruption and money trail have already emerged”.
Article Summary: Arvind Kejriwal claims Satyendar Jain's arrest was carried out 'under political pressure' Chief minister Rekha Gupta says Jain was involved in a ‘scam’ in Delhi Jal Board. Delhi BJP president Harsh Malhotra said AAP functionaries were playing the political victim card.

Article Title: Rs 1.27 crore for Mumbai police’s mounted unit
Article Text:
In 2019, the govt approved the creation of a Mounted Police Unit with 30 horses for the Mumbai Police Force

Mumbai:





The state govt approved Rs 1.27 crore for the mounted police unit of the Mumbai Police , and the money will be utilised to buy horses, saddlery, related equipment, veterinary and medical examination expenses for horses, remuneration of trainers and other such expenses.In 2019, the govt approved the creation of a Mounted Police Unit with 30 horses for the Mumbai Police Force.Subsequently, the govt approved the transfer of a sanctioned strength of 38 police officers and personnel to the Mounted Police unit, comprising one police sub-inspector, one assistant police sub-inspector, and 36 police constables. A permanent stable in Marol, Andheri, has been set up for the mounted police unit.
Article Summary: In 2019, the govt approved the creation of a Mounted Police Unit with 30 horses for the Mumbai Police Force. The money will be utilised to buy horses, saddlery, related equipment, veterinary and medical examination expenses for horses. A permanent stable in Marol, Andheri, has been set up for the mounted police unit.

Kolhapur

Gold and silver jewellery along with cash, collectively worth around Rs 8.6 lakh, were stolen from a house in Tarabai Park area of Kolhapur city on Monday between 5.30am and 7.30am.According to the police, the burglars broke open the rear door of the house located in Sahajivan Parisar area by using a metal rod. After gaining access they found the keys of the cupboard locker in which jewelry and cash were kept.A complaint has been filed at Shahupuri police station by the owner of the house Shirish Sadashiv Sankpal (31). The police have registered the case under sections 305(A) (theft) , 331(3) (trespass) and 331(4) of BNS 2023 on Wednesday.“The burglars must have studied the area and residents of the house before executing the crime. They also knew where the keys of the locker were kept,” a police officer said.Later on Wednesday, the police arrested a Kadamwadi resident, 42-year-old Sachin Sadashiv Hasurkar, and recovered the valuables stolen from Sankpal’s house.
Article Summary: Gold and silver jewellery along with cash, collectively worth around Rs 8.6 lakh, were stolen from a house in Tarabai Park area of Kolhapur city. The burglars broke open the rear door of the house located in Sahajivan Parisar area by using a metal rod.

Article Title: Ambernath BJP-MNS clash: Case registered against 2 BJP corporators, five others
Article Text:
A new case was filed against seven individuals, including two BJP corporators, following a clash.





AMBERNATH: The political clash between BJP and Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) workers in Ambernath has taken a fresh turn, with Shivaji Nagar police registering a fresh case against seven people, including two BJP corporators, on the complaint of an MNS worker who was injured in the incident.The latest case was registered on Sunday on the complaint of Suhas Ghag, a relative of MNS Ambernath city chief Shailesh Shirke, who was also injured in the clash. Police have booked BJP corporators Abhijit Karanjule and Pawan Walekar along with five others under sections 118(1), 115(2), 189(2), 190, 191(2) and 324(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).The development comes days after police arrested Shirke and some of his associates for allegedly assaulting BJP office-bearer Laxmi Narayan Chauhan at his office in Vadavali.A subsequent clash between BJP and MNS workers at Shivaji Nagar police station further escalated tensions.MNS leaders had alleged that police took one-sided action by arresting their office-bearers while failing to act against BJP workers allegedly involved in the assault on Shirke. MNS leader Avinash Jadhav had demanded action against those responsible.Following the demand, MNS district president Bandu Deshmukh had announced a protest on Sunday against what the party termed one-sided police action. However, after police registered an FIR against BJP workers, MNS withdrew its protest.
Article Summary: A new case was filed against seven individuals, including two BJP corporators, following a clash. The latest case was registered on the complaint of Suhas Ghag, a relative of MNS Ambernath city chief Shailesh Shirke, who was also injured in the clash.

Article Title: Rahul will interact with girl students on paper leak, women’s safety, employment in Pune: Congress
Article Text:
Rahul Gandhi

Pune:





Leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi will interact with girl students on women’s safety, examination paper leak and lack of employment opportunities during his visit to the city on Saturday as a part of Congress party’s “Chhatron ki Goonj" initiative.Senior members of the state Congress have been camping in the city ahead of Rahul’s visit to create a buzz, particularly among youths, about the event through musical performances, bike rallies and interaction with students on campuses. Former minister Satej Patil on Wednesday said the party was expecting thousands of girl students at Rahul’s event at AISSMS College of Engineering ground on Saturday.“The party is carrying out a registration drive before Rahul’s visit and getting a good response. We are expecting a large number of girls students to turn up at the event where Rahul will interact with them on various issues,” Patil said.The Pune police have issued a letter of permission to Congress to hold the event at AISSMS college ground with a gathering of of 8,000 to 10,000 people.
Article Summary: Rahul Gandhi will interact with girl students on women’s safety, examination paper leak and lack of employment opportunities during his visit to the city on Saturday. Senior members of the state Congress have been camping in the city ahead of the visit to create a buzz.

Article Title: Open Shivajinagar-Hinjewadi Metro route sans further delay: Opposition & IT forums
Article Text:
Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Metro Line 3

Pune:

TOI





Opposition party members in the state and IT professionals’ forums have demanded the govt begin operations of the Shivajinagar-Hinjewadi Metro route at the earliest without waiting for a formal launch function, after CM Devendra Fadnavis said he had invited the Prime Minister Narendra to inaugurate the line.IT professionals working in the Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park in Hinjewadi have been complaining about lack of infrastructure and public transport to the IT Park.President of the Forum for IT Employees Pavanjit Mane told: “Over 5 lakh employees work in the IT Park and face immense hardships due to lack of infrastructure. The opening of the Metro route will allow them a convenient mode of transport and reduce traffic on the streets.”“The Metro route should have opened before monsoon. The project has missed the deadline several times and should be opened without further delay. We heard the PM will inaugurate the route which is why it is taking time. Additionally, if PM Narendra Modi comes to Hinjewadi, he should give five to 10 minutes to us IT professionals to put forward our issues,” Mane added.The Metro Line 3 connects Shivajinagar with Hinjewadi. On July 23, the commissioner of Metro Rail Safety granted permission to commence operations for the first phase of the route.Fadnavis on Tuesday said that during his recent visit to New Delhi, he met PM Modi and invited him for the inauguration.Meanwhile, opposition has criticised the state govt for delaying the opening in wait of a formal launch.Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Aaditya Thackeray said, “State govt should give respite to IT professionals from traffic congestion by starting the Metro route at the earliest. It can organise the formal launch later. Unfortunately, this govt is more interested in inaugural functions than resolving people’s problems.”
Article Summary: Opposition party members in the state and IT professionals’ forums have demanded the govt begin operations of the Shivajinagar-Hinjewadi Metro route at the earliest. CM Devendra Fadnavis said he had invited the Prime Minister Narendra to inaugurate the line.

Article Title: Neighbour, 25, held for raping, strangling minor in Junnar
Article Text:
Pune:





A 25-year-old man from Junnar taluka was arrested on Wednesday for allegedly raping his neighbour’s nine-and-half-year-old daughter and strangling her to death on Tuesday.Pune Rural police made the arrest and said the accused dumped the girl’s body near a stream in a sugar cane field about one-and-half km from their area. Thereafter, he joined the search operation with villagers and the police team.Superintendent of police (Pune Rural) Sandeep Singh Gill said, “We took the man into custody after a villager alleged he had seen the girl with the accused on Tuesday. During sustained questioning, the man admitted to having raped and murdered the minor.”The officer said police recovered the girl’s body late on Tuesday night and sent it for a post-mortem examination.The man has been arrested under sections 103 (murder), 64 (rape), 65(2) (rape of a woman under 12 years of age), 140 (kidnapping in order to murder) and 238 (causing disappearance of evidence) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and relevant sections of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.Gill said the accused lived in the same neighbourhood as the girl’s family. On Tuesday, the victim was watching TV at home with another child. The accused approached and lured her by promising a guava. “He took the girl to a farm about one-and-half km away. He raped her near a stream, strangled her to death and went home,” he said.The officer said the girl’s parents returned home in the evening and found her missing. They looked for her in the village and then lodged a complaint with the police. “We registered a case of kidnapping around 8.30pm and began the search,” he said.A villager said the man had also joined the search. He said, “The man was seen riding his bicycle in the CCTV footage. Police received information about the accused’s involvement in the kidnapping and took him into custody.”Gill said, “The man admitted to raping and killing the girl. We have arrested him. We will submit the chargesheet to the court within 15 days.”Meanwhile, deputy CM Sunetra Pawar said the incident was extremely unfortunate and a stain on humanity. She said the Pune Rural police acted promptly and arrested the accused. “I will speak with CM and home minister Devendra Fadnavis and request the case be heard in a fast-track court,” she said.Pawar said she had spoken with Gill and reviewed the investigation. “Police have been directed to conduct a transparent and thorough investigation, and take stringent action against the accused,” she said, adding that she would visit the village and meet the girl’s family.
Article Summary: Pune Rural police made the arrest and said the accused dumped the girl’s body near a stream in a sugar cane field about one-and-half km from their area. The man has been arrested under sections 103 (murder), 64 (rape), 65(2) (rape of a woman under 12 years of age) and 140 (kidnapping in order to murder)

Article Title: Nashik police bust sex racket, one woman rescued
Article Text:
Nashik:





The central crime branch of Nashik city police busted a sex racket that was operating under the guise of a fitness centre in the Mumbai Naka area.The raid was carried out by the anti-human trafficking unit (AHTU) on Wednesday, leading to the rescue of one woman.Acting on confidential information, officials learnt that illegal commercial sex activities were being carried out at a bungalow in an area under Mumbai Naka.The establishment was masquerading as an operational fitness centre. Upon verifying the information, the police raided the bungalow and confirmed the illicit operations.Following the raid, the Mumbai Naka police registered a case under sections of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act against two individuals, and rescued a woman who was pressed into prostitution by the two persons for their own benefit.The raid was executed under the directions of the Nashik city police Commissioner Sandeep Karnik, DCP (Crime) Kirankumar Chavan, and ACP (Crime) Sandeep Mitke. Senior police inspector Yogesh Deshmukh led the operation raid.
Article Summary: The central crime branch of Nashik city police busted a sex racket that was operating under the guise of a fitness centre in the Mumbai Naka area. The raid was carried out by the anti-human trafficking unit (AHTU) on Wednesday, leading to the rescue of one woman.

Article Title: Torso case: Police release images of suspected couple
Article Text:
torso case





Chennai: Railway police have released CCTV images of a man and a woman who abandoned a decomposed and dismembered body of a man in a red suitcase inside the Tamil Nadu Express at Chennai Central railway station two weeks ago.The unidentified man’s decomposed and dismembered body was found inside an abandoned red suitcase in an unreserved coach of the Chennai-New Delhi Tamil Nadu Express after it reached Agra on Aug 5. The head and parts of the limbs were missing, prompting the Uttar Pradesh Government Railway Police (GRP) to register a case and seek assistance from their Tamil Nadu counterparts.Police said CCTV footage from Chennai Central showed a man and a woman, the latter wearing spectacles, entering the station with the red suitcase. The two were subsequently seen placing the suitcase inside a coach of the Tamil Nadu Express and getting off before the train departed.Investigators tracked their movements through CCTV cameras and found that the duo walked to Chennai Park railway station and boarded a suburban train towards Tambaram. Images released by police also show them travelling on the suburban train and later moving without the red suitcase.A senior railway police officer said the identities of the two have not yet been established. Investigators are examining footage from railway stations along the suburban route to trace their subsequent movements and identify them.The investigation gained momentum after Agra railway police recovered covers and receipts linked to a prominent textile store in Chennai from inside the suitcase. Tamil Nadu railway police have sought detailed case records, photographs of the deceased and other evidence collected by investigators in Agra to help establish the victim’s identity and reconstruct the sequence of events.Tamil Nadu and Agra railway police are jointly working to identify and trace the man and woman seen in the CCTV footage.
Article Summary: Unidentified man’s decomposed and dismembered body was found inside an abandoned red suitcase in an unreserved coach of the Chennai-New Delhi Tamil Nadu Express. The head and parts of the limbs were missing, prompting the Uttar Pradesh Government Railway Police (GRP) to register a case.

Article Title: Four vehicles involved in illegal sand mining seized in Krishnagiri, probe on
Article Text:
Those engaged in the illegal activity, abandoned the vehicles and fled on seeing the police approaching

Krishnagiri:





An earthmover and three tractors which were involved in illegal sand mining near Nagarasampatty in Krishnagiri district, were seized during the early hours of Monday.According to an officer, sand was being illegally excavated from the Nagaleri Lake under Avathuvadi panchayat around 2am on Monday. Acting on a tip-off, the village administrative officer S Dinesh inspected the site and confirmed that sand was being loaded into three tractors with the help of an earthmover.“Nagarasampatty police reached the spot based on his information. However, those engaged in the illegal activity, abandoned the vehicles and fled on seeing the police approaching,” the officer said.A case has been registered, and police are investigating further to trace and arrest the absconding culprits.(Photos: S Parthiban)
Article Summary: An earthmover and three tractors which were involved in illegal sand mining near Nagarasampatty in Krishnagiri district, were seized during the early hours of Monday. According to an officer, sand was being illegally excavated from the Nagaleri Lake under Avathuvadi panchayat.

Article Title: Custodial death: Kin refuse to receive body of man
Article Text:
The family members of a man who died due to alleged assault by police personnel at the Chintamani police station in Madurai district refused to accept the body, stating that they would not receive the body until they get justice.

Madurai:





The family members of a man who died due to alleged assault by police personnel at the Chintamani police station in Madurai district refused to accept the body, stating that they would not receive the body until they get justice.Paramasivam, 55, of Anuppanadi Housing Board was picked up by the police on July 19, following a scuffle over vehicle parking with his neighbours. He was admitted to hospital due to illness and died on August 16. His family members alleged that Paramasivam died due to injuries as he was assaulted by the police personnel. However, police denied the allegations.Meanwhile, in a petition filed by Paramasivam’s wife P Ayyammal, Madras high court ordered a magistrate inquiry in the case.Pursuant to the order, a team of experts from the forensic department performed postmortem on the body of Paramasivam at Government Rajaji Hospital in Madurai on Tuesday. However, the family members refused to accept his body.
Article Summary: Paramasivam, 55, of Anuppanadi Housing Board was picked up by the police on July 19, following a scuffle over vehicle parking with his neighbours. He was admitted to hospital due to illness and died on August 16. His family members alleged that he died due to injuries as he was assaulted by police personnel. Police denied the allegations.

Article Title: District planning committee members from Kochi corporation elected
Article Text:
Kochi

:





Members were elected to the district planning committee (DPC) from the Kochi corporation council on Wednesday.In the women’s category, Kavitha Harikumar was elected with 46 votes, and in the general category, Abdul Latheef was elected with 47 votes. Both are Congress councillors. District collector G Priyanka was the returning officer for the election.On Tuesday, representatives of the district panchayat to the DPC were elected. The election was held for members from the general, women and SC/ST categories from the 28 district panchayat members.In the SC/ST reserved category, Sona O S (Congress) was elected. In the SC/ST women’s reserved category, Ahalya Sadanandan (RSP) was elected.In the general category, Sujith Paul (Congress), Nadirsha (Muslim League) and Jomy Thekkekara (Kerala Congress) were also elected.In the women’s category, UDF candidates Shelmi Johns and Alphonsa David (both Congress) and Bini Shaji (Kerala Congress Jacob) received eight votes each. LDF candidate Mary Vincent received three votes.
Article Summary: Members were elected to the district planning committee (DPC) from the Kochi corporation council on Wednesday. In the women’s category, Kavitha Harikumar was elected with 46 votes, and in the general category, Abdul Latheef waselected with 47 votes.
